name: do
description: Turn a project's docs/TODO.md into an autonomous plan-and-code loop — evaluate the task list and hand it to ralphex-plan.

interface.shortDescription: docs/TODO.md as an autonomous plan-and-code loop
interface.longDescription: The do skill reads a project's docs/TODO.md, sizes the open work, picks a planning mode to match it, and hands the result to the ralphex pipeline. It also edits the task list (do add / do remove) and covers the early-PR and finalize flows.
defaultPrompt: Work through docs/TODO.md in this project.
